title: Isolated-standard local NIRCam measurement-operator adjudication

selection.selectionRule: Use every public CAL product whose precise FITS target coordinate falls on the detector; exclude out-of-footprint companion-detector products before reading pixels.

causalChain: public Cycle 3 isolated-standard CAL products and their delivered calibration reference state
unknown local repeatability of the SCI/PHOTMJSR*AREA aperture operator under the registered dither pattern
if the same operator is stable, four exposures per target-filter will agree and the matched NRCB1 dither signature will replicate across two stars and two dates
independently recomputed group scatter, dither excursion, DQ support, and cross-star matched-pattern difference
qualification of the local isolated-star operator only; a separate spatial/crowding holdout remains required before reopening TRGB or H0

competingHypotheses.claim: The official isolated-star aperture operator is locally stable at the sampled anchors.
competingHypotheses.prediction: All six groups retain 4/4 support, robust scatter is at most 1%, maximum dither excursion is at most 2%, and the matched NRCB1 pattern differs by at most 1% between the two standards.
competingHypotheses.decisiveTest: Run one frozen r=5 pixel aperture with a 20-35 pixel background annulus after SCI/PHOTMJSR*AREA conversion on all 24 products.
competingHypotheses.rejection: Failure of any registered support, DQ, scatter, excursion, or matched-pattern gate.

competingHypotheses.claim: A detector-position or sampling-phase signature dominates the residual.
competingHypotheses.prediction: Normalized flux changes with dither position and the same signed four-position pattern repeats for the two NRCB1 standards despite their different dates and spectra.
competingHypotheses.decisiveTest: Compare pattern-number-normalized NRCB1 residual vectors across WDFS0458-56 and WDFS0122-30 separately in F090W and F150W.
competingHypotheses.rejection: The pattern fails the 1% matched-replication gate or changes sign without a registered detector-state explanation.

competingHypotheses.claim: Source, epoch, or calibration-state dependence prevents local transfer.
competingHypotheses.prediction: Within-star repeats may be tight while matched NRCB1 patterns disagree across the two dates or filters.
competingHypotheses.decisiveTest: Use the difference of normalized pattern vectors, not their absolute stellar fluxes, so intrinsic source brightness cancels.
competingHypotheses.rejection: Both filters satisfy the 1% cross-star matched-pattern gate.

measurement.centroid: local maximum followed by three positive-flux center-of-mass iterations

uncertaintyBudget.samplingPhase: bounded by four registered detector positions and cross-star pattern replication
uncertaintyBudget.centroiding: reported as WCS-to-measured offset; r=3, r=5, and r=8 fluxes are retained for sensitivity analysis
uncertaintyBudget.background: 3-sigma iterated annulus mean with the retained scatter and sample count
uncertaintyBudget.badPixels: DO_NOT_USE flags within r=3 are a hard failure
uncertaintyBudget.sourceSpectrumAndBrightness: cancelled only in within-target normalization and matched-pattern differences; absolute cross-star flux is not compared
uncertaintyBudget.spatialExtrapolation: unbounded outside the three sampled anchors and therefore excluded from the claim

stoppingRules: Stop before flux measurement if any target-detector-filter group has fewer than four in-footprint CAL products.
Do not substitute another star, detector, aperture, or threshold after pixels are read.
If the local operator fails, do not reopen the crowded-field PSF, TRGB, distance, or H0 branches.
If it passes, advance only to a separately locked wide-position or crowded-field transfer holdout.
claimBoundary: Passing qualifies local isolated-star repeatability at NRCB1 and NRCA3 anchors. It does not validate full-detector spatial transfer, crowded-field PSF subtraction, TRGB edge recovery, distance, or H0.
